svg.title: Where the middle coefficient comes from
svg.desc: Two families of straight lines cross on the affine saddle z = uv. The full projective surface is a pair of projective lines. Modulo 5 the pair has 25 finite pairs, 5 with only u infinite, 5 with only v infinite and 1 with both infinite. The total is 36. Two strokes automatically trace the lines that meet at the origin.
svg.text: A patch of the saddle z = uv
Each square is a pair (u, v).
